title: Computer-use internal protocol 2.0 - reviewed planning contract
description: Internal host/controller protocol. Not a provider API. Wire version 2.0 is intentionally incompatible with 1.0. See BUILD_PLAN.md for authorization, projection, cancellation and replay invariants. This is a starter contract, not an implemented runtime.

description.description: Complete model-facing semantic action description; not a bare target ID.

coverage.description: Coverage relative to the requested region, never a claim about the entire computer.

isFinal.description: Committed input only. Partial transcript previews are native UI events, not commands.

Approval.description: Host-private record emitted only by the authenticated native approval UI. issuer is descriptive metadata, not authentication.

ClarificationReply.description: Selects one option in a host-registered displayed prompt. Free-text correction enters through a new committed Command and goal revision. This record does not authorize execution.

ResumeRequest.description: User intent to resume a host-registered paused checkpoint after fresh observation. Never itself dispatches or retries an unresolved effect.

name.description: semif is reserved for optional evaluation only, not a default production provider.

ExecutionReceipt.description: Delivery records handoff to the target API; effects and objective verification are separate. No exactly-once guarantee is implied. An already-completed desired state can succeed without new effects if evidence verifies it. Unknown objective outcome does not erase known delivery or effects; never infer replay safety from outcome alone.

ProviderView.description: Only this approved minimized projection is serialized to a model. All other DecisionRequest fields stay host-side. This distinction is enforced by implementation and tests, not by JSON Schema.

ExecutionPermit.description: Host-private registry record; a wire object with issuer=host does not prove provenance. Only the owning authenticated host channel may create this record.
